batch: WL80C - Compiled Neural Material Rules: bounded GPU feasibility smoke
status_rule: Frozen before any candidate (compiler / closure / oracle) result. Stage 0a reference-only survey (results/fnto_compiled80c/stage0/survey.json) informed ONLY the material domain (reference passivity filter). Amendments must be labelled, dated and state whether they precede or follow evidence.

resource_budget.rule: Sum of wall-clock of GPU stages (survey, data, train x2, oracle, eval, contract, bench, render) is logged in launcher/budget.log; before each stage the chain stops with STOPPED_BY_RESOURCE if the cumulative time exceeds 60 min. Dev smoke time is recorded separately and does not count.
resource_budget.contention: Check nvidia-smi compute apps before launching; bench marks results invalid if a foreign compute process is present before/after.

reference.renderer: Mitsuba 3.5.1 principled BSDF plugin (principled.so), Python API eval / pdf / eval_pdf / sample, cuda_ad_rgb on LabServer63
reference.semantics: Burley 2015 Disney principled BSDF as implemented by Mitsuba: Disney diffuse with retro-reflection, sheen, anisotropic GGX main specular with principled Fresnel, GTR1 clearcoat; reflection only (spec_trans = 0). eval() returns f cos(theta_o) in the local shading frame (x = anisotropy axis).

stage0a_findings.non_passive: 14 % of box materials exceed albedo 1 somewhere (max 1.32, grazing, low metallic): additive Disney layering is not energy conserving

reference.not_a_trivial_basis_match: The candidate basis (Lambert + Schlick-Fresnel anisotropic GGX lobes, wi-independent weights) cannot represent Disney diffuse retro-reflection / grazing darkening, sheen, GTR1 clearcoat or the principled Fresnel blend exactly; the reference main specular is one GGX lobe but with a different Fresnel. The oracle-P fit measures how close the basis can get.

passivity_filter.rule: keep a material only if the reference point-estimate directional albedo (defensive mixture MC, float64) is <= 1 for every channel and every wi on the grid (cos theta uniform in [cos 88deg, 1], random azimuth)

materials.heldout_block_rule: Training / validation / test_iid materials are drawn from the box EXCLUDING the block (joint combination: sharp + strongly anisotropic + clearcoated); each marginal range stays covered in training. test_block is drawn inside the block.
materials.splits: uniform in the box, rejection by block membership and passivity filter, in this order: train, val, test_iid (non-block); test_block (block); train_eval = first train_eval train materials (fresh directions)

angular.train_wi_distribution: cos theta_i uniform in [cos 88deg, 1], phi uniform, excluding theta_i in the held-out incident band
angular.wo_distribution: defensive mixture 0.5 reference sample() + 0.25 cosine + 0.25 uniform hemisphere (failed reference samples replaced by uniform for data, zero weight in estimators)
angular.eval_rule: Every evaluation direction is a fresh draw (unseen); theta 60 lies in the held-out band; theta >= grazing_min_deg is the grazing stratum.

highlight.definition: half-vector slope grid s in [-smax, smax]^2, wo = reflect(wi, normalize(-sx,-sy,1)); smax = clip(4 max(alpha_x, alpha_y) of the reference main specular, 0.12, 1.5); value = channel-mean eval. Peak = argmax; peak error = angle between reference and closure peak wo (deg). Width = 0.5 log(area ratio) of the half-maximum regions (cells with value >= 0.5 peak), only when neither region touches the grid boundary. Pronounced highlight: reference peak >= 3 x a_ref(wi) cos(theta_peak) / pi.

candidate.closure: f(m,wi,wo) = sum_{r=0..7} lambda_r(m) B_r(wi,wo; phi_r(m)), R = 8 (fixed, no sweep): B_0 Lambert 1/pi; B_1..7 anisotropic GGX (alpha_u, alpha_v in [0.004, 1], frame-aligned) x Schlick Fresnel (F0_r in [0,1]) x height-correlated Smith G2 / (4 cos_i cos_o)
candidate.weights: RGB lambda_rc = softmax over 9 slots (8 lobes + absorption) per channel: lambda >= 0, sum_r lambda_rc <= 1
candidate.passivity_argument: each lobe albedo <= 1 for every wi (Lambert = 1; GGX: F <= 1 and G2 <= G1(wi) -> albedo <= int D_wi = 1), hence albedo_c(wi) <= sum_r lambda_rc <= 1 (flux measure int f cos dwo)
candidate.reciprocity_argument: f symmetric: D(h), G2 symmetric, Schlick uses wi.h = wo.h, no wi-dependent normalisation
candidate.sampling: lobe r with wi-independent probability p_r proportional to mean_c lambda_rc * w_r (w_0 = 1, w_r = F0_r + (1-F0_r)/21); Lambert cosine warp; GGX visible-normal sampling (spherical caps, Dupuy & Benyoub 2023); pdf = sum_r p_r pdf_r (GGX pdf_r = G1(wi) D(h) / (4 cos_i), sub-normalised by below-horizon failures that get weight 0); weight = eval / pdf
candidate.compiled_state: 45 independent floats per material (lambda 24, alpha_u 7, alpha_v 7, F0 7) + 8 derived sampling probabilities; runtime expands derived constants to 88 floats
candidate.compiler: MLP 9 -> 128 -> 128 -> 128 -> 48, SiLU, descriptor normalised to [-1,1] over the box; head weights x0.1, head bias = deterministic init (log-spaced isotropic alpha 0.01..0.8, F0 0.5, uniform lambda logits); evaluated once per material (compile time), never per hit
candidate.runtime: Dr.Jit / Mitsuba types (closure80c_dr.py) for contract tests, benchmark and rendering; torch implementation (closure80c.py) for training and Stage-2 evaluation; equality checked in the unit tests

training.loss: mean over lanes and channels of (log(1 + eval_closure) - log(1 + eval_ref))^2
training.checkpoint: final step only (no selection on validation; validation loss is logged)

oracle.definition: oracle-P: per test material, free raw closure parameters (same basis, rank, constraints and loss), optimised on that material's fit set (fresh training-style directions, not the evaluation directions); two inits (generic init bias; compiler seed-8001 output), choose by final fit loss. oracle-U (diagnostic only, not a gate): same but lambda = softplus (>= 0, no sum bound), initialised from oracle-P; separates the passivity bound from basis expressivity.

metrics.E_L1: per (material, wi): sum_samples use * sum_c |eval_cl - eval_ref| / q  /  sum_samples use * sum_c eval_ref / q (energy-weighted L1 lobe error relative to the reference albedo; 1024 fresh mixture samples, paired)
metrics.E_alb: per (material, wi): sum_c |a_cl,c - a_ref,c| / sum_c a_ref,c with a = directional albedo int f cos dwo (same samples)
metrics.aggregation: median / p90 / p95 over all (material, wi) groups of a set; strata by theta; descriptor-tercile medians of per-material mean E_L1

representation.rule: PASS iff R1 (E_L1) and R2 (E_alb) and R3 (pronounced highlights: median peak error and median |log width ratio|). CLEAR FAIL (stop before Stages 3-5) iff oracle-P median E_L1 > 0.20 or median E_alb > 0.06.

learned_rule.rule: Per seed: L1 test_iid median E_L1 <= 0.15 and <= max(1.5 x oracle-P, oracle-P + 0.03); L2 test_block median <= 0.20 and p90 <= 0.40; L3 test_iid median <= 1.25 x train_eval median; L4 E_alb medians iid <= 0.05, block <= 0.08; L5 pronounced highlights (test_iid) median peak error <= 1.5 deg and median |log width ratio| <= log 1.25; L6 held-out band median <= 1.25 x band-neighbour (50/70 deg) median and grazing median <= 2 x overall median. PASS iff all for BOTH seeds.

physical_contract.rule: PASS iff all of C1-C7 pass on every closure set (both seeds x test_iid / test_block, and the adversarial random closures)
physical_contract.C1: no non-finite / negative eval, pdf or sample weight on random full-sphere inputs incl. degenerate wo = -wi, wi = wo = n, theta = 90deg, wi.z = 1e-8; below-horizon -> exactly 0; no valid sample below the horizon
physical_contract.C2: reciprocity of f = eval / cos_o: max rel <= 1e-3 where max f > 1e-4
physical_contract.C3: passivity: albedo via the closure's own sampler (16384 samples, 8 theta incl. 88deg); violation if a - 1 > max(4 se, 1e-3); zero violations and max sum lambda <= 1 + 1e-6
physical_contract.C4: per GGX lobe: VNDF success fraction vs an independent NDF-proportional estimate of int pdf_r over the upper hemisphere; fraction of cases with |diff| > 1e-3 and z > 4 <= 1 %
physical_contract.C5a: returned pdf equals pdf(wi, wo) and weight equals eval / pdf (rel <= 1e-4)
physical_contract.C5b: chi-square (32 theta x 64 phi bins + failure bin, 8x8 midpoint sub-grid expected counts, 262144 samples) on closures whose lobes with p_r > 0.01 all have alpha >= 0.05; fraction with p < 1e-3 <= 5 %
physical_contract.C6: MC estimator consistency: int f cos L by the VNDF mixture sampler vs an independent NDF mixture sampler (8192 samples each; L in {env_lobe, sky, sun64}); fraction z > 4 <= 1 % and |t| of the mean relative difference <= 4
physical_contract.C7: support: no direction with eval > 1e-6 and pdf = 0

sampling_utility.rule: learned seed-8001 closures on test_iid, theta in {10,45,75}, the three lightings: relative variance per sample of the closure sampler+eval estimator divided by that of the reference sampler+eval; PASS iff median <= 2.0 and p90 <= 5.0

performance.rule: Dr.Jit CUDA kernel-history GPU time, same GPU, same tracing path. At the largest io and fused16 sizes, for eval_pdf and sample: median REF/CMP speedup >= 1.10 and >= 6 of 8 materials >= 1.10; no foreign GPU process. Otherwise FAIL (slower or no measurable advantage). Break-even N* = compile cost / (t_ref - t_cmp) only if t_cmp < t_ref.

bench.materials: first 8 test_iid materials; CMP uses seed-8001 compiled states; SIMPLE = roughconductor GGX alpha (0.2, 0.05) on material 0 only (sanity)
bench.timing: GPU time = sum of execution_time of all kernels launched by one op (dr.kernel_history, JitFlag.KernelHistory); wall = trace + launch + sync; warmup reps discarded (kernel cache primed); median, p10, p90 reported
bench.compile_cost: compiler forward + decode + compiled-state transfer + runtime closure binding, single material and batch of 1024 (median of 50 after 10 warmups)

stage5_render.precondition: REPRESENTATION, LEARNED_RULE, PHYSICAL_CONTRACT and PERFORMANCE all PASS; otherwise NOT REACHED
stage5_render.plan: Mitsuba path integrator (max_depth 6), identical scenes / lights / spp / seeds, principled vs compiled closure registered as a Python BSDF plugin; scenes: anisotropic sphere under a point light + constant environment (highlight), sphere on a Lambert floor in a closed box with an area light (indirect); two lighting configurations each; a rigid 30deg rotation of the sphere; 3 test_iid materials (seed-8001 compiled); 256 spp both arms vs a 4096 spp principled reference; LabServer63 cuda film accumulation is known wrong -> per-pass integrator.sample accumulation without the film, validated by a white-furnace test first, else stop and report.
stage5_render.criteria: compiled 256-spp relative L1 error vs the 4096-spp reference <= principled 256-spp error + 0.02 on every image, highlight ROI relative error <= 0.10, and compiled total render GPU time <= principled; report noise at matched spp, memory and recompilation cost.

final_status_mapping.LOCAL_CLOSURE_FEASIBILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED: representation or learned rule or physical contract FAIL, or a measured performance FAIL (split verdict reported explicitly)
final_status_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: mixed results that the frozen rules cannot classify (e.g. seeds disagree)
final_status_mapping.STOPPED_BY_CONTRACT_OR_RESOURCE: budget exhausted, invalid GPU measurement (contention) or a blocking contract / production-modification requirement before the question is answered

not_authorised: rank / basis / loss / threshold changes after candidate results
production FNTO / C1 / historical code changes
